This event occurred about three hours after the landslide that triggered catastrophic flooding in Nepal and China . It was identified during post-processing of low-frequency seismic records and shows characteristics consistent with a landslide. Due to the lack of high-frequency energy, the location of this event was estimated from satellite images. For more information see the USGS landslides special event page.
